question: Why is the protector of the field called the lord of the field and identified as of that nature?
premises: Protecting the field is the defining action stated.
One who protects the field is thereby designated its lord.
The lord is further described as consisting of that nature.
inference: Because he protects the field, he is indeed the lord of the field and is of that very nature.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic role of '-śavasyai' in this verse is unclear.
plain_english: Because he protects the field, he is indeed the lord of the field and is of that nature.
